text: Classical extensional mereology requires that every object be ultimately composed of atoms, and is therefore inconsistent with 'gunk' (matter every part of which has a further proper part).
explanation: False. Classical mereology is neutral on atomism: it is fully consistent with atomless gunk, in which every part has a further proper part. The axioms (supplementation and unrestricted fusion) do not entail that decomposition terminates in simples.
